sections.title: IMPORTANT - DELOAD/TRANSITION WEEK
sections.description:
Hi Team,

We’re wrapping up our current training block this week.

Week 4/4 will be what I call a transition week.

What does that mean? After three weeks of rigid, structured progressions, we're going to change things up. We do so in order to balance the rigidity and flexibility that make up a great training program for CrossFit. 
Too much structure and set systems has its limitations, just as too much variance and chaos does.
For us, based on the last 11 years of programming/training/coaching, we've found a 3-week "on" / 1-week "off" routine to be the most effective way to balance out the above.

This transition week looks very different to how we normally build the training programs, so if you are new to the team, please keep that in mind.

There will be less training overall this week to allow for better quality and better recovery, so that you are ready for a new training week starting next Monday.
 
Intensity is self-regulated. If you feel great, push. If you don’t, dial it back.
_______________________
Monday 20th of July we start fresh and continue our progressive overload. I can’t wait to show you what’s coming.
– André Houdet
nst

sections.title: WARM UP
sections.description:
Warm up 

a. 60/60 sec Dynamic Posterior hip stretch 

b. 4 minutes Row (Easy-Moderate tempo)
-Into-
1 round for quality: (Rest as needed between movements)
30 sec Hamstring bridge hold
10 Barbell Good-mornings
30 sec Mid-shin deadlift hold with barbell
10 Romanian deadlifts
-Into-
Build to starting weight for the Floating RDLs

sections.title: STRENGTH ENDURANCE / HYPERTROPHY (Hinge)
sections.description:
Strength Endurance/Hypertrophy, Posterior Lower-body (Hinge)

a. 5 sets, Going every 3rd minute
(Option #1) 10 Floating Romanian Deadlifts  
(Option #2) 20 GHD Hip extensions

Why two options: I've listed a more taxing option (RDL), perform this one if you feel good, and a less taxing option (GHD hip extensions), perform this if your posterior chain feels affected from yesterdays hang cleans.

Load: Same load across all sets. Suggested loads below:
Floating RDLs:
[Elite] 100/70kg | 225/155lbs
[RX]  80/55kg | 185/125lbs
[Intermediate] 60/40kg | 135/95lbs

GHD Hip extensions:
[Elite] 30/20kg | 65/45lbs Plate(s)
[RX]  20/15kg | 45/35lbs Plate
[Intermediate] 10/5kg | 25/15lbs Plate
 
Tempo: (Floating RDLs) Controlled descent, Small pause in the bottom where the plates are right above the floor, fast up. Quality and control are key.

sections.title: STRENGTH ENDURANCE / HYPERTROPHY (Press and Pull)
sections.description:
Strength Endurance/Hypertrophy, Anterior & Posterior Upper-body (Press and Pull)

a. 10 sets, Alt. Exercise every 90 sec: (15 minutes)
1: 10 Seated DB Arnold press
2: 10 Pendlay Rows

Load: Use the first round as a warm up round, then find a challenging weight to stick to for the last four rounds. 
Estimated loads:
Arnold press:
[Elite] 2x22.5/15kg │ 2x50/35lbs
[RX] 2x17.5/12.5kg │ 2x40/30lbs
[Intermediate] 2x15/10kg │ 2x35/25lbs

Pendlay rows:
[Elite] 70kg │ 155lbs
[RX] 60kg │ 135lbs
[Intermediate] 50kg │ 115lbs

sections.title: STRENGTH ACCESSORY (Squat)
sections.description:
Strength Accessory, Anterior Lower-body (Squat) 

a. 3 sets, 2 minutes on / 2 minutes off
45 sec plate loaded prisoner wall-sit hold (hands behind head)
-Into-
Max-distance sled push (moderate load) or Lunges (loaded) for the remainder of the interval

Load:
[Wall sit] 20-40/10-20kg on top of legs
[Sled] Surface-dependent. Pick a load you can keep moving for the full interval.

No Sled? No problem: 
Simply perform walking lunges in the remaining time instead of the sled. If you have a long sandbag, GoRuck, weighted vest or a 22.5/15kg | 50/35lbs slamball/DB, then use that.

sections.title: OPTIONAL EXTRA (Upper-body)
sections.description:
Optional Extra, Upper-body

Option #1 (Cables)
a. 3 sets for quality of (rest as needed between exercises)
Max Cable bicep curls 
-Rest 90 sec-
Max Cable Tricep extensions
-Rest 90 sec-

Option #2 (DB's + Bands)
a. 3 sets for quality of (rest as needed between exercises)
Max DB Hammer curls (2x10-12.5/6-8kg │ 2x25-30/15-20lbs)
-Rest 90 sec-
Max Banded Tricep extensions (Blue/Red band)
-Rest 90 sec-

A "Max" set: Go to failure each set.
